اقتعدوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَعَدُوا (iqtaʕadū) /iq.ta.ʕa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اُقْتُعِدُوا (uqtuʕidū) /uq.tu.ʕi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اِقْتَعِدُوا (iqtaʕidū) /iq.ta.ʕi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
